scope: Dated construction, reconfiguration, and voltage history for the Great Northern Peninsula transmission lines in IC-270

source.title: IC-270, Northern Peninsula Transmission Line Construction History

engineering_records.label: Construction record
facts: Hydro records TL221 as a 66 kV line built between Daniel's Harbour and Hawke's Bay Terminal Stations

engineering_records.label: Peter's Barren reconfiguration
facts: TL221 was terminated at Peter's Barren when that terminal station was added
The Daniel's Harbour to Peter's Barren section was renumbered TL262

engineering_records.label: Construction record
facts: TL241 was built between Hawke's Bay and Plum Point Terminal Stations
The line was built to 138 kV standard and initially operated at 66 kV

engineering_records.label: Extension and 138 kV operation
facts: TL241 was extended to Peter's Barren Terminal Station and commenced operation at 138 kV
The former TL241 66 kV termination at Hawke's Bay was removed from service

engineering_records.label: Construction record
facts: TL244 was built between Plum Point and Bear Cove Terminal Stations to 66 kV standards

engineering_records.label: 138 kV upgrade
facts: TL244 was upgraded for operation at 138 kV

engineering_records.label: Construction record
facts: TL256 was built as a 138 kV line between Bear Cove and St. Anthony Airport Terminal Stations

engineering_records.label: Construction record
facts: Hydro records TL261 as a 69 kV line built between St. Anthony Airport and St. Anthony Diesel Plant Terminal Stations

engineering_records.label: Construction record
facts: TL257 was built as a 69 kV line between Roddickton Woodchip and St. Anthony Airport Terminal Stations
